text.p: Tropical Cyclone Freda, with 70 mph winds, is southeast of New Caledonia over the open waters of the southwest Pacific. Freda is maining a risk to shipping this period. It should gradually weaken and eventually dissipate with time.

Tropical Cyclone Gretelle, with 50 mph winds, is in the southern Mozambique Channel near 27s/37e, moving west-southwest at 8 mph. Gretelle is expected to turn more to the south but strengthen slightly during the next 24 hours, threatening shipping.
Tropical Cyclone Pancho-Helinda, with 70 mph winds, is in the southern Indian Ocean near 12s/91e. It is mainly a risk to shipping in the area.
Tropical Cyclone Iletta, with 45 mph winds, is in the southern Indian Ocean near 18s/72e, moving southeast at 10 mph, and is expected to slowly weaken with time.
There are no further statements at this time.
